== Overview ==

The '''AX Multi-Cannon''' is an Aegis projectile weapon designed to apply anti-xeno damage with sustained fire. Standard versions are sold in class 2 and class 3 fixed or turreted mounts. They use human technology, require no Technology Broker unlock, and remain usable where an anti-Guardian field would disable susceptible Guardian weapons.<ref name="axi-weapons">Anti-Xeno Initiative, [https://wiki.antixenoinitiative.com/en/weapons Weapons].</ref>

Its low barrier to entry does not make it the strongest current choice. [[Enhanced AX Multi-Cannon|Enhanced AX Multi-Cannons]] offer better projectile performance and include a gimballed option; the standard weapon remains a serviceable scout killer or an immediately available fallback, particularly in a large turreted mount, but is outclassed in most new builds.<ref name="axi-weapons" /><ref name="frontier-enhanced">Frontier Developments, [https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/galnet/enhanced-ax-weapon-project Enhanced AX Weapon Project], 15 December 2022.</ref>

The fixed mounts deal more damage per shot. The turreted mounts sacrifice damage for automatic tracking and easier sustained fire, although the class 3 turret remains the most practical standard variant for hunting fast-moving Scouts.<ref name="edwiki-axmc">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/AX_Multi-cannon AX Multi-cannon].</ref>

== Operation ==

The weapon fires continuously while its trigger is held and ammunition remains in the current clip. It applies anti-xeno damage without special ammunition synthesis, but performs poorly against conventional human ships compared with an ordinary multi-cannon.<ref name="edwiki-axmc" />

Against a Thargoid Interceptor, AX Multi-Cannons can damage the hull and an exposed heart. Fixed mounts can be aimed directly at the visible heart. A tracking mount needs the Interceptor scanned with a [[Xeno Scanner]] before its heart can be selected as a subtarget; without a completed scan it tracks the main hull instead.

The weapon is generally better suited to Scouts and the weakest Interceptor engagements than to stronger Interceptor variants. Its sustained-fire profile also makes distance, target motion, and time on target important: a missed burst consumes ammunition without providing the high single-shot effect of specialised Guardian weaponry.

=== Experimental-weapon limit ===

AX Multi-Cannons count towards the ship's standard limit of four experimental weapons. An Experimental Weapon Stabiliser can raise that limit, but additional weapons still increase hardpoint, power, distributor, heat, and ammunition demands.<ref name="axi-weapons" />

=== Engineering ===

Standard AX Multi-Cannons cannot receive conventional [[Engineering|Engineer]] blueprints or Experimental Effects. They should be compared as fixed stock modules rather than as bases for a custom multi-cannon build.

== Acquisition ==

AX Multi-Cannons are purchased for credits through Outfitting. Stock varies by station, economy, class, and mount, so check a current outfitting finder before travelling for a particular variant. No material unlock is required for the standard Aegis versions.

== Choosing a version ==

* Choose '''class 3''' when a large hardpoint is available; its penetration and damage are markedly better than the class 2 weapon.
* Choose '''fixed''' for maximum damage and manual heart aiming.
* Choose '''turreted''' for easier tracking, multicrew use, or dedicated Scout hunting.
* Choose an [[Enhanced AX Multi-Cannon]] for a new general-purpose human AX build unless availability or an existing loadout gives the standard model a specific role.
* Use a [[Xeno Scanner]] when a tracking mount must target an Interceptor's exposed heart.

== Related modules ==

* [[Enhanced AX Multi-Cannon]] — improved human AX multi-cannon with fixed, gimballed, and turreted mounts.
* '''Advanced Multi-Cannon''' — conventional multi-cannon that can use synthesised anti-xeno ammunition.
* [[AX Missile Rack]] — human AX dumbfire missile launcher.
